issue.body:
The main motivation of this change is to allow third party backends like
diesel-oci to speciaize `QueryFragment` impls without using the unstable
`specialization` feature. This is done by introducing a new marker trait
`SqlDialect` that has an associated type for each specializable
`QueryFragment` impl.

Beside of that this allows us to fix a few long standing issues:
* `eq_any` can now use `= ANY()` on postgres
* We can now support batch inserts for sqlite as long as there is no
default value in the insert values

Fixes #2898
Fixes #2694 (by deprecating the corresponding functions)

issue.title: Regression: eq_any for tuples in 2.0.0-rc.0

issue.body:
<!--
If you want to report a bug, we added some points below which help us track down the problem faster.
-->

## Setup

### Versions

- **Rust:** 1.62
- **Diesel:** 2.0.0-rc.0 
- **Database:** postgres 13
- **Operating System** Linux


## Problem Description

Regression of https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/issues/2045.


### Steps to reproduce
`Cargo.toml`
```toml
[package]
name = "diesel-regression"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

# See more keys and their definitions at https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/manifest.html

[dependencies]
diesel = { version = "2.0.0-rc.0", features = ["postgres"]}
```

`main.rs`
```rust
use diesel::prelude::*;
use diesel::sql_types::Record;

diesel::table! {
    use diesel::sql_types::*;

    something (id) {
        id -> Int4,
        key_one -> Text,
        key_two -> Text,
    }
}

fn main() {
    let inputs: Vec<(String, String)> = vec![("one".to_owned(), "two".to_owned())];
    let conn = todo!();
    let matching = something::table
        .filter(
            (something::key_one, something::key_two)
                .into_sql::<Record<_>>()
                .eq_any(inputs),
        )
        .load(conn);
    println!("Hello, world!");
}

```

Compilation error (the one that matters):
```
error[E0277]: the trait bound `(String, String): ToSql<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>, Pg>` is not satisfied
    --> src/main.rs:23:10
     |
23   |         .load(conn);
     |          ^^^^ the trait `ToSql<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>, Pg>` is not implemented for `(String, String)`
     |
     = help: the following other types implement trait `ToSql<A, DB>`:
               <(std::collections::Bound<T>, std::collections::Bound<T>) as ToSql<Nullable<diesel::sql_types::Range<ST>>, Pg>>
               <(std::collections::Bound<T>, std::collections::Bound<T>) as ToSql<diesel::sql_types::Range<ST>, Pg>>
     = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `ToSql<Array<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>>, Pg>` for `[(String, String)]`
     = note: 1 redundant requirement hidden
     = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `ToSql<Array<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>>, Pg>` for `Vec<(String, String)>`
     = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `QueryFragment<Pg, pg::backend::PgStyleArrayComparision>` for `diesel::expression::array_comparison::Many<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>, (String, String)>`
     = note: 6 redundant requirements hidden
     = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `QueryFragment<Pg>` for `SelectStatement<FromClause<table>, query_builder::select_clause::DefaultSelectClause<FromClause<table>>, query_builder::distinct_clause::NoDistinctClause, query_builder::where_clause::WhereClause<diesel::expression::grouped::Grouped<diesel::expression::array_comparison::In<pg::types::record::PgTuple<(columns::key_one, columns::key_two)>, diesel::expression::array_comparison::Many<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>, (String, String)>>>>>`
     = note: required because of the requirements on the impl of `LoadQuery<'_, _, _>` for `SelectStatement<FromClause<table>, query_builder::select_clause::DefaultSelectClause<FromClause<table>>, query_builder::distinct_clause::NoDistinctClause, query_builder::where_clause::WhereClause<diesel::expression::grouped::Grouped<diesel::expression::array_comparison::In<pg::types::record::PgTuple<(columns::key_one, columns::key_two)>, diesel::expression::array_comparison::Many<Record<(diesel::sql_types::Text, diesel::sql_types::Text)>, (String, String)>>>>>`
note: required by a bound in `diesel::RunQueryDsl::load`
    --> /home/tomas/.cargo/registry/src/github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823/diesel-2.0.0-rc.0/src/query_dsl/mod.rs:1489:15
     |
1489 |         Self: LoadQuery<'query, Conn, U>,
     |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ required by this bound in `diesel::RunQueryDsl::load`

```
